purpose: Form BEN-4 is a notice given by a reporting company to members holding not less than ten percent of shares, voting rights, or right to dividends, to seek information about significant beneficial owners.
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Take steps to find out if there is any individual who is a significant beneficial owner.
Identify any member holding not less than ten percent of shares, voting rights, or right to dividends.
Give notice in Form No. BEN-4 to such member seeking information.
checklist: Verify that the reporting company has members holding not less than ten percent of shares, voting rights, or right to dividends.
Ensure Form BEN-4 is prepared as the notice seeking information.
watch: If a person fails to give the information required by the notice in Form BEN-4 or gives unsatisfactory information, the reporting company shall apply to the Tribunal.
